instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Commercial property management firm operating 12 office buildings, 3 retail centers, and 2 logistics parks totaling 120,000 m² of leasable area. Managing 400+ tenant relationships. Seeking to implement IoT-based building energy management and a tenant experience mobile app.
answers.pastInitiatives: Our digital transformation program is in its third year with a dedicated transformation office reporting to the CEO. We have completed an ERP migration to the cloud, rolled out a company-wide data warehouse with self-service BI dashboards, and established a center of excellence for process automation using RPA and low-code tools. The program has delivered €2.4M in annualized cost savings to date.
answers.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on a single product category and a concentrated customer base — our top 3 clients represent 55% of revenue. This concentration risk is unacceptable for our long-term health. We need to identify and develop new revenue streams, possibly including new product lines for different customer segments or entirely new business models that leverage our existing capabilities.
answers.additionalContext: The existing operational infrastructure relies heavily on legacy systems that limit seamless third-party integration, creating friction for rapid service delivery improvements.
answers.teamSize: We have a small technology team of 4-6 people including developers, a part-time DevOps engineer, and a product manager who also handles project management. The team is fully allocated to maintaining current products and handling integration requests from key clients. Innovation work is done in the margins — there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.

opportunities.title: IoT Energy Management Integration (Quick Win)
opportunities.rationale: Implementing IoT-based building energy management offers immediate operational efficiency gains and provides a tangible value proposition for tenants, aligning perfectly with the short time horizon.

first_actions: Identify three pilot buildings for smart thermostat installation
Select and procure necessary sensor hardware within Q2
Conduct feasibility study on data integration requirements
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 15% reduction in energy consumption across pilot buildings within 6 months.
milestones: Decision on scaling or abandoning tech

opportunities.title: B2B PropTech SaaS Platform Development (Diversification)
opportunities.rationale: Developing a specialized B2B platform for facility management reporting allows Synapse Group to pivot from service dependency toward creating scalable, recurring software revenue streams.

first_actions: Define the minimum viable product (MVP) features for facilities reporting
Conduct market validation interviews with 5 prospective corporate clients
Identify and hire a specialized part-time development contract
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 3 paying B2B SaaS pilot customers within the first year.
milestones: Beta launch with initial corporate clients (Month 7)

opportunities.title: Tenant Experience App Feature Expansion (Optimization)
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging the existing digital app base, focusing on high-margin feature enhancements can improve tenant satisfaction and reduce churn among key corporate clients.

first_actions: Conduct targeted user surveys on current app pain points
Prioritize top 3 requested features for Q3 development cycle
Allocate existing product manager time to sprint planning
resources_needed: Internal allocation of existing staff time (no new headcount)
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase tenant engagement metrics (login frequency) by 20% within 4 months.

next_steps.action: Establish a dedicated Innovation Steering Committee and define 3 strategic diversification targets for the next 18 months.
Conduct detailed scoping workshops with IT and Finance to model the capital requirements and operational risks for the B2B SaaS platform idea.
Launch a pilot project focused solely on IoT energy management in one building to demonstrate quick ROI capability.

key_weaknesses: Severe reliance on concentrated revenue streams (top 3 clients) creating high diversification risk.
Limited budget allocation for formal innovation activities (€5% constraint makes radical projects challenging).
Resource bottleneck: The small technology team is fully allocated to maintenance, leaving no capacity for exploratory or radical innovation work.
Cultural inertia against rapid experimentation and scaling new business models.
